title: How to Start a Monthly Donor Program Without a Big Donor List
actionable_recommendations: Start a simple monthly donor program for predictable revenue.
Choose realistic giving levels based on audience demographics.
Define donor experience rather than perks to strengthen connections.
Craft a clear program name and message that highlights community impact.
claims_requiring_current_verification: Nonprofits can raise $20K–$100K in about 90 days with a monthly donor program.
No success is guaranteed as outcomes depend on various factors.
major_ideas: Importance of sustainable revenue for small nonprofits through monthly donor programs.
Clear communication of program purpose to donors.
Emotional connection with donors is crucial for retention.
prerequisites: Understanding of average one-time gifts or realistic donor demographics.
A basic branding strategy that resonates with target demographics.
proposed_workflow: Set up giving levels based on realistic expectations.
Create a program identity that feels emotionally connected to donors.
Identify and personal outreach to potential donors.
tools_templates_resources: A clean website landing page for the monthly donation program.
Email templates for personal outreach to potential donors.
A simple monthly donation form and informational materials.
A short welcome video for new donors.
Story-based key messaging to include in communications.
